Item 1. Business

Acme Widgets designs and sells industrial widgets in North America and Europe. The Company employed approximately 12,400 people at year end.

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Total revenue increased 12.5% to $4,500 million in 2024, compared with $4,000 million in 2023, driven by higher widget volumes.

Operating income was $630 million in 2024 versus $500 million in 2023.
